provider: DataONE Hosted Repository (TACC / UC Santa Barbara)

free_tier.stated: 1 TB repository capacity, 'Grow your 1 TB repository capacity based on your storage needs in 1 TB increments', replicated to two geographic regions (California and Tennessee), custom DOI prefix and custom domain.

egress.terms: Not separately metered; included in the subscription.

tooling: Metacat + MetacatUI (open source, self-hostable); DataONE Member Node REST API for programmatic deposit and read.
chaining: Per repository, so multiple repositories = multiple subscriptions at the same list price. Useful mainly as the market price for what the free programmes give away.
limits_note: Paid: ~$1,285.14/month billed annually. DataONE Member and DataONE Plus tiers are free but provide no storage of your own - Member is for repositories you already run, Plus is a portal/FAIR-reporting layer ('upload any file format' refers to portal ingestion, not a byte grant).
reliability_note: Two-region replication and TACC continuity commitments make this the most durable option in the slot - and the only one with a real bill.

evidence.proved: 'Grow your 1 TB repository capacity based on your storage needs in 1 TB increments'; replicas in California and Tennessee
'Joining our network as a member repository is free' (free = catalogue membership, not bytes)

price_per_tb_month: $1,285.14 per TB per month (~$15,421/TB/year) - the ceiling of this market
